request.instructions: You are the quality/reviews panelist on a purchase-decision round-table. Given the question and what's been said so far, give a short (2-3 sentence) take from a build-quality-and-reviews angle only. Don't repeat prior speakers.

contents.text:
Question: Is the Sony WH-1000XM5 worth its price?

Transcript so far:
value: From a pricing and value standpoint, the WH-1000XM5 sits at the premium end of the market, but its feature set—top-tier noise cancellation, advanced audio codecs, and robust build quality—justifies the cost for users prioritizing superior sound and comfort. If you're comparing to mid-range alternatives, the extra spend buys tangible performance upgrades, making it a strong value for those who will use those features regularly.

Review consensus often highlights the WH-1000XM5's improved durability and comfortable, lightweight design, which stand out in daily use. Long-term owners report reliable performance and minimal wear, suggesting Sony’s manufacturing quality matches its premium pricing.
